{{Top}}
'''Class One infractions''' were one of the five categories of crime outlined in the [[Imperial Penal Code/Legends|Imperial Penal Code]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] alongside [[Class Five infraction/Legends|Class Five]], [[Class Four infraction/Legends|Class Four]], [[Class Three infraction/Legends|Class Three]] and [[Class Two infraction/Legends|Class Two]] infractions.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> Crimes in this category included, but were not limited to: 
*Conspiracy to overthrow the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]
*Ownership of a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]]
*Attack of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]
*Harassing of an imperial ship

Being the most serious offense in Imperial Law, the law was enforced even on the further edges of civilized space.<ref name="GG6" /> Standard Imperial punishment for this type of violation ranged from 5 to 30 [[Standard_year/Legends|years]] on an [[Garen IV penal colony|Imperial penal colony]] for all offenders. In case a starship crew was found guilty of a Class One infraction, their vessel was also immediately impounded until claimed by the owner.<ref name="GG6.2e">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)]]</ref>
